text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to follow up on my application for the Software Development Engineer I position at Cobalt Fintech. I remain very interested in the role and in contributing to your engineering team. 

During my recent internship as a Backend Developer at Ledgerly Payments, I built REST APIs in Java 17 and Spring Boot, optimized PostgreSQL queries to improve report generation speeds, and participated in an on-call rotation. My background also includes working with Kafka consumers, Redis, and data structures and algorithms through competitive programming and project work.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my backend development experience aligns with your team's needs.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
